instruction: Populate res://scenes/main.tscn so Main contains a water depth visualization scene: add a WorldEnvironment with a procedural sky and glow enabled, a DirectionalLight3D with shadows enabled, a MeshInstance3D named Water that uses a 10x10 PlaneMesh subdivided 20x20 with a ShaderMaterial pointing at res://scenes/WaterShader.tres, a Background Node3D holding exactly 5 sphere MeshInstance3Ds at these positions (all within the 10x10 water plane): Sphere at (-3.900, 0.300, -3.600); Sphere2 at (3.200, -0.200, 4.100); Sphere3 at (-0.800, 0.500, -4.400); Sphere4 at (4.700, -0.400, -1.200); Sphere5 at (-4.600, 0.000, 2.000), all with green StandardMaterial3D overrides, and add a Camera3D so all spheres are visible Set the Camera3D FOV to 30 and set the camera Y position to 1.0.
